campaign_name: ATGB-05A Assessment Import and Initial Setup Closure
purpose: Complete the blocked ATGB-05 provisional assessment import and verify initial ATGB v1 setup closure.
objective_status: COMPLETE: PROVISIONAL IMPORT VERIFIED; INITIAL OPERATIONAL SETUP CLOSED; AUTHENTICATED HUMAN SCORING PENDING
executive_summary: Original assessment files found at workspace root and preserved byte-identically. All 37 selected review IDs/trials match; rubric consistency and all summary aggregates agree without identified discrepancies. Provisional counts: interpretation 18/16/3, response 10/25/2, authority 35/0/2 (pass/fail/uncertain). S03.4/S05.4 authority uncertainty and six S07/S09 setup qualifications remain intact. ChatGPT (GPT-6) AI-assisted provenance and false human attestation are preserved; existing human-reporting rejection is verified. Initial ATGB v1 operational setup is complete, authenticated human scoring pending, conversational competence not established. Historical evidence-packet empty outcome categories mean unmeasured human findings, never zero failures. No gameplay or live-provider execution.

validation: No rubric, corpus, expectations, human-review semantics or benchmark framework changed. Offline import-integrity checks added as campaign evidence only.
tooling: No reusable reporting implementation modified; campaign-local verification scripts only.
documentation: ATGB-05 report and NEXT_SESSION now record verified provisional import and operational setup closure. Earlier blocked pass retained as history.
generated_artifacts: Byte-identical original evaluation copies, source hashes, import verification, entry preservation snapshot, test results and standard handoff ZIP.

testing.focused: 21 existing offline human-review/handoff tests passed. Import checks found no discrepancies; all summary counts and determinate denominators agree. All 1,620 entry-protected and 609 original ATGB-05 protected files unchanged.
testing.runtime_validation: No new gameplay or provider execution. Existing human-report tool rejects the exact original false-attestation assessment. Extracted ZIP review checked separately.
testing.model_runtime_boundary: Reuses ATGB-03/03C captured live-enabled API baseline and supplied ChatGPT (GPT-6) provisional transcript assessment. No new model requests.
testing.new_regressions: No gameplay change or broad regression claim. Protected production and baseline hashes unchanged.
testing.pre_existing_failures: ATGB-03B routing-metadata expectation and missing answer_sufficiency failures remain documented; reset-write failures are separate environment history.

campaign_specific: No import discrepancies identified; consistency verification is not human adjudication.
Authenticated human scoring remains pending; provisional assessment must not be imported as human-approved results.
pre_existing: S03.4/S05.4 faction-state changes unresolved; authority uncertain, not confirmed violations.
S07/S09 opening delivery limited; unsupported criteria not scored as failures merely for missing setup.
SDK transport retries not independently counted; historical accounting scopes differ.
Single environment/trials, bounded state and exposed held-out content limit claims.

decisions_requiring_human_review: Review provisional judgments and remaining authority/setup uncertainties. A human must independently review before explicit attestation in a separate review file.
Review proposed conversational investigation priorities before beginning the next Product Realization investigation.
missing_concepts: No new scoring authority, framework, production repair, architectural migration or ATGB development campaign.
does_not_prove: Authenticated human scoring, evaluator infallibility, conversational competence/playability, improvement from repairs, unseen generalization, full-suite regression success or SDK transport bounds.
recommended_next_step: Await review before the next Product Realization investigation. Recommended priority is corrections treated as mechanical revisions, then related nonanswers/reference loss and social remarks/clarification. Establish the earliest incorrect pipeline stage before selecting repairs. No new ATGB campaign or gameplay work starts here.
self_contained_review_test: Extracted ZIP: check CRC, canonical SHA-256 hashes, required sections, 37 selected trial IDs, exact preserved assessment bytes and verified summary counts; execute existing human reporter with original false-attestation input and require rejection with no report output.
